scene: G1 minefield reconnaissance and sensor-driven traversal; manipulation disabled
official_requirements: After the start command, identify and remove colored wires in the required order.
The slide reference describes red/yellow targets and decoy targets.
Then pick supplies in the required list order and place them into the designated first-aid kit.
